name: js-ts-acceptance
body: Acceptance for the unified frontend: a JavaScript repo (CJS and ESM, plus a dynamic-require case) and a mixed JS/TS repo scan cleanly; the frontend's own source (src/tslib) contributes symbols after the port; dynamic constructs produce unresolved targets only. Tests exercise a scratch /tmp repo per no-real-project-test. AC: the listed fixtures scan and the emitted edges match the exactness rule.
